answer: Each epoch opens 200 work slots on the terrace, and claiming one burns a 60-copper deposit, no refund, no transfer. A gale of fresh signups cannot flood in, since every slot is paid in burned copper first. Forging 1,000 identities burns 60,000 copper against an epoch pool of only 12,000 POA: the attack costs five times what it could steal. An honest agent pays one 60-copper burn, keeps its full share, and never shares it with priced-out fakes.
